mapper.select: SELECT category_id as id, parent_id as parentId, category_name as title FROM article_category ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT category_id as id, parent_id as parentId, category_name as title FROM article_category WHERE category_id != #{excludeId} AND category_id NOT IN ( -- 排除直接子分类 SELECT category_id FROM article_category WHERE parent_id = #{excludeId} UNION -- 递归查找所有子分类（最多支持3级） SELECT c1.category_id FROM article_category c1 INNER JOIN article_category c2 ON c1.parent_id = c2.category_id WHERE c2.parent_id = #{excludeId} ) ORDER BY sort_order ASC
